payload.title: install is noise, not a wizard
payload.body: Operator observation after installing 0.6.0: `cratylus install --harness <harness>` should by default be a guided, good-looking, lean wizard, but today it prints a bucket of internal detail and ends in one y/n confirmation; it is neither intuitive nor lean. Intended: the default run asks only what the operator must decide (harness, which personas, persona launch commands, model roles), shows what will be placed before placing it, and ends with a short summary of what was done and what to do next; the detail now printed goes behind a verbose flag. Rectified library choice: commander is an argument parser, not a wizard; for the interactive flow the current community choice is @clack/prompts (Astro, Svelte and Nuxt scaffolders use it), with @inquirer/prompts the established alternative; argument parsing stays with the existing parser or commander/citty. Belongs to first-share piece 3 (consumer surface: install wizard, a nicer CLI with consumer commands first).
